_comment: Deploy-artifact size budgets (bytes), enforced by check_deploy_artifact.mts. Baseline measured 2026-07-19: total 3,296,290 (js 1,088,841 · wasm 84,952 · csv 2,034,758 · css 82,298). Budgets sit ~15% above baseline so incidental growth passes and UNEXPLAINED growth fails. Raising a budget is a deliberate act: re-measure, name the cause (new feature, new wasm kernel), and bump the number in the same change.
